AI & Automation Engineer
WaveSix · Berlin, Berlin, Germany (On-site)

About the job

What You'll Do

You'll design and ship AI systems and automation workflows that solve real business problems. You know when to reach for an LLM and when a simple rule or lookup table does the job better — and you build accordingly.

Experience with data engineering is a meaningful plus: DAGs, ETL pipelines, and agent workflows share the same core challenges around reliability, observability, and failure handling.

What You Bring

The Role

You'll design and ship AI systems and automation workflows that solve real business problems. You know when to reach for an LLM and when a simple rule or lookup table does the job better — and you build accordingly.

Experience with data engineering is a meaningful plus: DAGs, ETL pipelines, and agent workflows share the same core challenges around reliability, observability, and failure handling.

You'll Build

• Data pipelines and orchestrated automation workflows
• AI pipelines with LLMs, embeddings, and retrieval where they add real value
• RAG systems and agents grounded in real company data
• Integrations that connect AI outputs to actual business tools and processes

What We're Looking For

Core:

• Python, LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), prompt engineering and evaluation
• RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases
• Workflow automation and orchestration — agents, triggers, conditional logic
• Strong judgment on when to use AI vs. deterministic logic

Big plus:

• ETL/ELT pipeline design, SQL, data modeling, API integrations
• Airflow, Prefect, dbt, BigQuery/Snowflake, cloud (GCP/AWS/Azure)

Bonus:

• LangChain/LlamaIndex
• n8n/Make/Zapier
• Docker

You Likely…
